title: Torn-off cluster appears at drop point using physical coordinates from drop monitor
context: Without explicit positioning, Windows cascade new windows from top-left of primary monitor, far from the cursor on multi-monitor setups.
decision: Pass explicit position using physical coordinates from the monitor under the cursor. Apply position after building window (not in builder), so window never appears at wrong place on screen.
consequences: Cluster dragged onto second screen opens on that screen. Drag-to-second-monitor feature actually works.
